tests.name: Binance Crypto: coupled retention matrix (6 observables)
tests.observable_names: BTC_price, BTC_volume, ETH_price, ETH_volume, SOL_price, SOL_volume
tests.verdict_note: SUPPORTED: eigenmode improves R² by +0.166 over single curves with coupling=0.414. T7 applies: the principal retention mode captures structure that individual observables miss.
tests.narrative: Binance Crypto: 6 coupled observables analyzed. Cross-retention matrix R_ij(λ) computed with 25 lags. Principal eigenvalue fitted to S2: D_eff=0.6199, λ_q=197.7893, R²=0.9942. Average single-curve R²=0.8278. Improvement: +0.1664 (+16.6%). Coupling strength=0.414 (High (strong coupling)). SUPPORTED: eigenmode improves R² by +0.166 over single curves with coupling=0.414. T7 applies: the principal retention mode captures structure that individual observables miss.
